notes.title: More than 200 wishlists!
notes.notes: [p]Two weeks now after the announcement of the game and we just hit our first goal of [b]200 wishlists![/b][/p][p]We want to thank everyone for all the support you gave us and we will be giving you some new information talking about the game systems and every unclear aspect of the game (without spoilers).[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2]We're heading to Next Fest![/h2][p]We're now heading to Steam Next Fest in October if everything goes as planned, that means you will be able to try the game soon and give us some feedback so we can improve the game![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Development (not) diaries[/h2][p]Another important notice is that we will be preparing some dev posts (maybe posts, maybe videos, will depend on the content) when we find something interesting for you to see and also to give you some updates on the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We won't make them diary or weekly, but more like when we feel we have something interesting to say/show about the development.[/p][p][/p][p]We can't say yet when the posts will start, but ideally will be next month.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]And that's all for today![/b][/p][p]Stay tuned and follow us on our socials![/p][p][/p][p]X: [url="https://x.com/oniric_tales"]https://x.com/oniric_tales[/url][/p][p]Bluesky: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/onirictales.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/onirictales.bsky.social[/url][/p][p]Tiktok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@roadtrip.teom"]https://www.tiktok.com/@roadtrip.teom[/url][/p]
